name: HSM Kit Tool Directory
description: Client-side cryptographic, HSM key management, payment security, PKI, and encoding tools.
privacy: Calculations run in the browser. Do not enter production keys, credentials, personal information, or live payment data.

tools.name: AES Encryption
tools.description: Encrypt and decrypt AES data with common modes, paddings, and encodings.

tools.name: DES and 3DES Encryption
tools.description: Encrypt and decrypt DES and Triple DES test data.

tools.name: RSA Encryption
tools.description: Generate RSA keys and test RSA encryption, decryption, signing, and verification.

tools.name: ECC and ECDSA
tools.description: Generate elliptic-curve keys and test ECDSA signatures.

tools.name: Format-Preserving Encryption
tools.description: Test format-preserving encryption for fixed-format values.

tools.name: ASN.1 Parser
tools.description: Decode and inspect ASN.1 DER and BER structures.

tools.name: SSL Certificate Tools
tools.description: Inspect certificates and generate keys, CSRs, and test certificates.

tools.name: Hash Calculator
tools.description: Calculate common cryptographic and non-cryptographic hashes.

tools.name: Character Encoding Converter
tools.description: Convert text and bytes between ASCII, EBCDIC, Unicode, and hexadecimal formats.

tools.name: BCD Converter
tools.description: Encode and decode packed and unpacked binary-coded decimal values.

tools.name: Check Digit Calculator
tools.description: Calculate and validate Luhn, Mod 10, Mod 9, and related check digits.

tools.name: Base64 Encoder and Decoder
tools.description: Encode and decode Base64 text and hexadecimal data.

tools.name: Base94 Encoder and Decoder
tools.description: Encode and decode compact Base94 values.

tools.name: Message Parser
tools.description: Parse structured payment and ISO 8583 test messages.

tools.name: RSA DER Public Key Decoder
tools.description: Decode RSA public keys in DER and PEM formats.

tools.name: UUID Generator
tools.description: Generate and inspect UUID values.

tools.name: Key Generator and KCV
tools.description: Generate AES and DES keys and calculate key check values.

tools.name: Keyshare Generator
tools.description: Split and recombine cryptographic keys using XOR components.

tools.name: Futurex Key Tool
tools.description: Work with Futurex HSM encrypted key formats for testing.

tools.name: Atalla Key Tool
tools.description: Work with Atalla key block formats for testing.

tools.name: SafeNet Key Tool
tools.description: Work with SafeNet HSM encrypted key formats for testing.

tools.name: Thales Key Tool
tools.description: Work with Thales LMK-encrypted key formats for testing.

tools.name: Thales Key Block
tools.description: Encode, decode, and inspect Thales key blocks.

tools.name: TR-31 Key Block
tools.description: Encode, decode, and inspect ANSI X9.143 TR-31 key blocks.

tools.name: AS 2805 Message Tool
tools.description: Parse and inspect AS 2805 payment messages.

tools.name: ISO 8583 Bitmap
tools.description: Create and decode ISO 8583 primary, secondary, and tertiary bitmaps.

tools.name: CVV and CVC Calculator
tools.description: Calculate CVV, CVV2, iCVV, and related card verification values for tests.

tools.name: American Express CSC
tools.description: Calculate American Express CSC variants for test data.

tools.name: Mastercard Dynamic CVC3
tools.description: Calculate Mastercard dynamic CVC3 values for test data.

tools.name: TDES DUKPT
tools.description: Derive TDES DUKPT keys and process test transactions.

tools.name: AES DUKPT
tools.description: Derive AES DUKPT keys for test transactions.

tools.name: ISO 9797-1 MAC
tools.description: Calculate ISO/IEC 9797-1 message authentication codes.

tools.name: ANSI X9.9 and X9.19 MAC
tools.description: Calculate ANSI X9.9 and retail X9.19 MAC values.

tools.name: AS 2805 MAC
tools.description: Calculate AS 2805.4.1 message authentication codes.

tools.name: TDES CBC-MAC
tools.description: Calculate Triple DES CBC-MAC values.

tools.name: HMAC Calculator
tools.description: Calculate keyed-hash message authentication codes.

tools.name: CMAC Calculator
tools.description: Calculate AES and Triple DES CMAC values.

tools.name: Retail MAC
tools.description: Calculate ISO 9797 retail MAC values.

tools.name: ISO 9564 PIN Blocks
tools.description: Encode and decode ISO 9564 PIN block formats.

tools.name: AES PIN Block Format 4
tools.description: Encode and decode ISO 9564-1 format 4 AES PIN blocks.

tools.name: IBM 3624 PIN Offset
tools.description: Calculate and verify IBM 3624 PIN offsets for test data.

tools.name: Visa PIN Verification Value
tools.description: Calculate and verify Visa PVV values for test data.

tools.name: Visa Certificate Validation
tools.description: Inspect and validate Visa payment certificate test data.

tools.name: ZKA Key Derivation
tools.description: Derive keys used by German ZKA payment systems for testing.
